post.description: Compare home broadband deals for a UK address (postcode + uprn from lookup_addresses) or nationally. One page per call (limit, default 20, max 50); pass next_cursor back as cursor with the same filters for the next page. Fails with not_found when Uswitch does not recognise the postcode/uprn pair.

contract_lengths.description: Only these contract lengths in months, e.g. [12, 24].

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; keep the same filters and sort.

limit.description:
Deals per page, 1-50 (default 20).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50.

max_monthly_cost.description:
Only deals whose monthly price is at most this many pounds.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

min_download_speed_mbps.description:
Only deals with at least this advertised download speed.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

postcode.description: Full UK postcode, e.g. 'E17 4LN' (case and inner space are normalised). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{1,2}[0-9][0-9A-Za-z]?\s*[0-9][A-Za-z]{2}$.

provider_ids.description: Only these providers (ids from list_providers or available_filters.providers).

sort.description:
Uswitch SORT_BY (default RANK_ASC, Uswitch's own ranking).

Provider reference: allowed values ["RANK_ASC", "COST_ASC", "COST_DESC", "EFFECTIVE_COST_ASC", "SPEED_ASC", "SPEED_DESC", "CONTRACT_LENGTH_ASC", "CALLS_ASC", "CALLS_DESC", "BAND_SPEED_ASC", "BAND_SPEED_DESC", "REAL_SPEED_MIN_ASC", "REAL_SPEED_MIN_DESC", "REAL_SPEED_MAX_ASC", "REAL_SPEED_MAX_DESC"].

uprn.description: UPRN of the address, from lookup_addresses. Requires postcode. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,14}$.

With postcode and uprn the feed is availability-checked for that premise; with a postcode alone the first residential address at the postcode is used; with no address it is the national 'widely available' feed.
